title: cert.rs: TooDeep Display hardcodes '10' instead of referencing MAX_DEPTH
description: CertChainError::TooDeep Display impl writes 'certificate chain exceeds maximum depth of 10'. The number 10 is hardcoded as a string literal, but MAX_DEPTH = 10 is defined in cert.rs. If MAX_DEPTH is changed, the Display message becomes stale. Use format!("certificate chain exceeds maximum depth of {MAX_DEPTH}") with a const or reference MAX_DEPTH. However since CertChainError is in error.rs and MAX_DEPTH is in cert.rs (a private module), Display can't access it directly. The variant should carry the depth as a field, or the hardcoded value should have a // keep in sync with cert::MAX_DEPTH comment.
